load.mode: Closed loop with one pre-established persistent HTTP connection per Nginx worker
load.latency: HTTP dispatch to response completion; excludes external arrival queue
load.payload: Same upstream Media field distributions and per-dispatch-index seed as closed_loop_load.py
load.warmup_error_policy: Retain startup application/transport errors. Restore a closed warmup connection only to its originally assigned Nginx worker, with no setup HTTP requests. No reconnects or application errors are allowed after warmup; failures remain fatal. Same 50s warmup and 60s E2E ROI as the original harness.

diagnostic_window: 35 seconds including a 10-second startup allowance for retained HTTP application errors; no reconnects or steady errors. Gate deltas include that startup interval. No E2E inference.
timing: Age starts at sched_switch selection, not at first user instruction. Slots use invariant TSC ticks; half-window split is <5us versus 5..10us.
